guidetextdraw._value:
INSTRUCTIONS: 

  1. Indicate TERM and appropriate EIP Self-Support PROGRAM.
  2. Select REQUESTED ACTION from pull-down menu (ADD, CHANGE, CHANGE TO, CANCEL).  *For class cancellations, please provide a REASON.
  3. Provide all class schedule information.  For multi-component classes (eg Lecture class with non-enroll Lab), list ALL components.  If section 70 class is parallel to a state-side section, or to another self-support section, please provide parallel section info.
  4. Provide all requested Faculty Information.
  5. Route for Dept Chair and Associate Dean Approval.  Submit to EIP Program Lead for processing.
guidetextdraw.name: EIP_Instructions_Text

guidetextdraw_2060463519._value:
INSTRUCTIONS: 

  1. Select from the pull-down menu for the type action requested (Change, Change To, Cancel, or Add). 
  2. Provide Class Schedule Information.  For a multi-component class, be sure to list ALL components; select from the pull down menu for type of component (ACT, LECT, LAB, etc.). 3. Provide all requested Faculty Information.  

NOTES: 

  1. Once the schedule has gone LIVE, you may not change class times or days, but must instead cancel that particular section and add a new section with the new times or days. 
  2. For Combined Sections, please obtain approval signatures from all appropriate department chairs and college deans. 
  3. If desired selection is not available in drop down box, manually type information in field.
